verdict.rationale: Meilisearch Cloud claims read high availability with native clusterization, and a community report confirms a replicated/distributed version exists in paid tiers. Self-hosting docs describe only a single binary, and the largest hands-on report is ~80M documents on one box, so no documented scaling path to hundreds of millions is shown. Missing for 10: documented clustering/replication/sharding guides for self-hosting, write HA or failover details, evidence of scaling to hundreds of millions of documents, depth beyond a one-line Cloud marketing claim.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, documented scaling paths — clustering, replication, high availability — carry me from prototype to hundreds of millions of documents

citations.quote: Guarantees the Read High Availability of the service with native support for clusterization.
A self-hoster runs ~80M documents (191GB, 13 indexes) on a 64GB Hetzner box
